title: Forest Arena two fighter combat v2
owned_catalog_policy: Keep all four character and six accessory IDs; normalize only executable selections, preserving preset and ownership history.

rules_v5_optional_fields.hitstun_multiplier: int > 0; default1, current2; applies after weight and original clamp
rules_v5_optional_fields.ring_out_hide_margin: float >= 0; current256 below stage ring bounds

combo_buffer: Middle ground-light PRESS only: recovery-relative -12..17, one reservation, starts after recovery; no HOLD or finisher reservation
falling_ring_out_state: FALLING_OUT appended to preserve prior enum values; lower-bound-only, hidden after lower bound+256, stock charged once after60 hidden ticks
debug_setting: Session-only local bool, defaultfalse; displays authoritative geometry without changing combat
presentation_boundary: UI, sprites and procedural effects read values only; they never resolve damage, action restriction, hit detection or winner.

attack_v4_optional_fields.hit_windows: Array[Dictionary]: global active 1-based tick and boxes:Array[Rect2]; optional per-pulse damage/knockback/launch_mode/launch_vector/hit_reaction/pull_ticks/pull_stop_distance
attack_v4_optional_fields.air_lock: int: 0 none, 1 extra jump and attack restriction, 2 all actions
attack_v4_optional_fields.attack_movement: int: 0 none, 1 fixed endpoint behind first enemy

snapshot_fields.debug_geometry: {hurtbox:{} or {x:number,y:number,w:number,h:number},hitboxes:Array[{x:number,y:number,w:number,h:number}]}; authoritative world rectangles, empty during non-interactive elimination states

motion_policy: Candidate-only until independent action review and explicit approval for each new or changed motion. Existing approved motion reuse does not imply approval of new choreography.
